name: ConneXionONE Corp.
summary: ConneXionONE Corp. currently maintains minimal operational presence. The company's past endeavors involved supplying fuel injection systems, specifically including DME fuel injection technology, for internal combustion engines. Its future direction is centered on the creation of a decentralized social media platform. Originally founded in 1997 as Alternative Fuel Technologies, Inc., the organization rebranded as ConneXionONE Corp. in October 2018 and is situated in Albrightsville, Pennsylvania.
